title: Condensed point module categories and geometric base change
statement:
Fix a universe $u$. Condensed rings mean ring objects in abelian sheaves on the coherent site of profinite sets [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Write $\mathrm{Coefficients}$ for the category of commutative such ring objects, with their ring-object morphisms. For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and a condensed ring $R$, let $R_X=p_X^*R$ be its pulled-back ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and define
$$\mathrm{Modules}(R,X)=\operatorname{Mod}_{R_X}(\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\operatorname{Ab})),$$
using internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $p_X^*\dashv p_{X*}$ be the composite point adjunction of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. Define the point module direct image
$$\mathrm{pointModules}(R,X)=\operatorname{Res}_{\eta_R}\circ p_{X*}^{\mathrm{Mod}}:\mathrm{Modules}(R,X)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Mod}_{R}(\operatorname{Sh}(*_{\mathrm{proet}},\operatorname{Ab})),$$
where $p_{X*}^{\mathrm{Mod}}$ uses the lax monoidal direct image and $\eta_R:R\to p_{X*}p_X^*R$ is the unit of that actual composite adjunction; restriction uses its actual scalar action. For fields $k,k^s$ with a specified $k$-algebra structure and $k^s$ a separable closure of $k$ [def-pd-separable-closure], and a morphism $a:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, define
$$\mathrm{geometricScheme}(k,k^s,X,a)=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k^s,\qquad
\mathrm{geometricProjection}(k,k^s,X,a)=\operatorname{pr}_1.$$
Schemes and fields are in universe $u$ and abelian coefficient groups in universe $u+1$. These are definitions of the categories, point functor and pullback scheme, with no Galois-descent conclusion.
